purpose: Phase 16 process-incident follow-up: a lab that runs the legacy 2.0.0 package must not be able to reach host loopback services (the protected demo engine listens on the host's port 8081).
method: A decoy HTTP listener on host 127.0.0.1:18999 (a port nothing else uses) stands in for the demo; the protected demo's own port was never probed. The same probes ran from a lab container WITHOUT isolation and from one WITH it.
mechanism: docker-compose.yml extra_hosts maps host.docker.internal and gateway.docker.internal to 192.0.2.1 (RFC 5737 TEST-NET-1, never routed) in the lab's Splunk container.

without_isolation (nsp16u_splunk).conclusion: a lab container reaches host loopback services by that name, which is how Phase 15 reached port 8081

with_isolation (nsp16l_splunk).2.0.0 gateway /health with no engine con: no answer within 60 s (HTTP 000): the request went to the blackhole, nothing answered

note: No credentials appear here. The protected demo and the remote reference Splunk were not contacted in this phase.
